senses.gloss:
हुर्, हूर् (a Kvip formation fr. rt. हुर्छ्; gen.
sing. हुरस्), one who goes crookedly, a deceiver,
dishonest.
—हुरश्-चित्, त्, m. (according to Sāy. on
Ṛg-veda I. 42, 3. हुरस् is from a Kvip formation,
the final छ् being dropped), a deceiver, thief, (in
Naigh. III. 24. = स्तेन, according to Sāy. = कौ-
टिल्यस्य or कौटिल्येन सञ्चेतृ, a collector of
crookedness or one who collects crookedly.)

हूर्छन, अम्, n. the act of going crookedly,
crookedness, craft, dishonesty, cunning.
हूर्छित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone crookedly; deceived.
हूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, = हूर्छित above.
